text_block_list.name: Television
text_block_list.text:
Also seen at the Embassy of Ireland's gala
yesterday was a distinguished young guest
currently studying abroad at the Japan

Umamusume Training Center Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was the first time I heard of her—a
news snippet blaring from a
TV in an
electronics store window.

Hmm... What should I do? ...Oh! Pardon,
may I have a moment of your
time?

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Indeed I do. Hehe, I'm terribly sorry to
have startled you. I was
hoping to consult
a local about something.

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You see, I heard that this convenience
shop had a dining counter. I
purchased a
cup of ramen and took it to a seat, but...

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid the server never came to
prepare
the noodles. Would you
happen to know if
the dining service is closed today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm about as perplexed as she is, but I
explain that convenience stores have
hot-water dispensers for customers to
make the ramen
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eh? I get to make it myself?! Me, making
ramen?! Why, that... that...

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds wonderful! If I may ask,
where might I find this
hot-water
dispenser?

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sigh. That was such a lovely experience! To have shopping, cooking, and dining services all in one shop—it really is convenient!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I cannot thank you enough for your kind
guidance. ♪ Now, if I may
ask...

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Could I trouble you to escort me to Ramen
Rampage?

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, no, I'm sorry! Ehehe,
it seems I got
ahead of myself. A local
student would
look the route up online, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mean... yeah, probably. But her way of
saying it leaves me slightly
concerned—it's
like she's never stepped out into the real
world before.

text_block_list.name: Owner of Ramen Joint
text_block_list.text: ...Seiyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Did he... He did! He just did the
Rampage Colander Cross! I
can't believe
I'm seeing it live!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's the technique he uses to drain
the starchy water he boiled
the ramen in. It
preserves the integrity of the noodles'
texture and the flavor of the rich chicken
stock!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
When I read about it online, I just knew I
had to see it for myself!
Ahhh... It was
worth the forty-three-day wait!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The glistening beads of water, cast
vigorously into flight but inches from my
eyes... The chef's passion stokes the
appetite more than I ever could have
imagined!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I truly cannot thank you enough for
escorting me. You have my
deepest
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but you did. I have no doubt I'll be
cherishing this experience for
the rest of
my life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the pure excitement in her eyes...
For some reason, I feel like
the moment
will linger in my memory too.

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's almost sundown! That's a shame. I
was thinking to squeeze in
one more stop.

text_block_list.name: Regal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I know,
but it's not the dormitory's curfew
I'm—Oh.

...Your Highness, please pardon the
intrusion, but your excursion was only
permitted on the grounds that you would
return by sunset. Please make your way to
the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next thing I know, we're surrounded by
impending figures in suits.
Where did they
all come from?!

text_block_list.name: Suit-clad Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And you—it was not our intent to disturb
your conversation.
However...

text_block_list.name: Suit-clad Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Our charge, Fine Motion, descends from a
royal bloodline. Though
her noble house
has since come to reside in Ireland...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your concern,
Captain. I'll
return to the dormitory as
soon I finish
thanking my gracious host.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I hope my security didn't scare you.
Thank you again for
everything. I made
some truly wonderful memories today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please take this as a token of my
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She places something in my palm with a
firm handshake and then turns to leave,
allowing the security guards to lead her
away to the
station.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Frozen from shock,
it's not until they leave
that I'm able to look at
what she gave me.
It's...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A Ramen Rampage coupon.
